Class BaseDAO<T>

java.lang.Object
dao.BaseDAO<T>
Type Parameters:
T - domain object handled by the DAO
Direct Known Subclasses:
AvailabilityDAO, EmployeeDAO
public abstract class BaseDAO<T> extends Object
Generic DAO providing basic CRUD operations for a table.
